definitions.source_version: NCBI scoremat.asn and seqport_util.cpp at d4d56d4aa4fe16964e54c8c101fb1ec631ec6c05
definitions.coordinates: Zero-based positions and residue-row indices; master mapping is not a target-subject identification.
definitions.defaults: ASN defaults only: absent isProtein=true; absent byRow=false; absent finalData.scalingFactor=1 only when finalData is present. Reported presence remains in the sheet.
definitions.real_decoder: Native REAL {mantissa,base,exponent} means mantissa*base**exponent, base 2 or 10. Decimal base 10 and exact Fraction base 2 are converted once to finite binary64. Decimal literals retain their token. Nonzero values rounding to zero and nonfinite/overflow values are unavailable with an issue, never measured zero.
definitions.array_status: Every defined matrix/vector native path is available, unavailable (absent or unrepresentable), or incompatible (type, cardinality, dimensions or storage order). One bad array does not suppress valid siblings.
definitions.status: Complete means the represented arrays and master mapping are decoded with no issues; absent optional sibling arrays/diagnostics need not exist. Partial preserves available matrices when any required mapping/value is absent or incompatible. No available matrix yields unavailable, or incompatible for invalid syntax/types/geometry.
definitions.no_combination: Components are retained individually. No sum, probability, annotation confidence, generated sequence, family prevalence or statistical uncertainty is inferred.

matrix_values.scores.formula: For M=numRows,N=numColumns: output[p][r]=input[r*N+p] if effective byRow, else input[p*M+r]; require M*N values. No division by scalingFactor.
matrix_values.scores.population: Each model position and alphabet row; no external biological-population denominator
matrix_values.scores.missingness: Absent is null/unavailable; wrong length/type is null/incompatible; unrepresentable REAL is null/unavailable. Original array remains in sheet.
matrix_values.scores.identity: Native final PSSM score, including negative and sentinel-like values

dimensions.missingness: Missing/invalid dimension is null; dependent matrix unavailable.

residue_alphabet.formula: Use M supplied string labels; only when rowLabels is absent use protein code indices 0..25 or 0..27, or nucleotide 0..15, from native tables.
residue_alphabet.population: M native matrix rows, no resorting
residue_alphabet.missingness: Invalid supplied labels or unsupported unlabelled dimensions retain matrix indices but labels are null.

master.formula: Decode supported exact protein codes; verify declared length=decoded length=N; retain native column p and symbol. master_position is null for '-', otherwise p; later native positions are not renumbered. This differs from the CLUSTAL ungapped-master map.
master.population: The explicit single master Seq-entry only
master.missingness: Missing, compound or unsupported master leaves mapping null; length mismatch retains decoded sequence but map is null.
master.identity: Decoded supplied master, not model-generated consensus or target-subject sequence

native_parameters.formula: Retain supplied parameters including native REAL representations; no current executable defaults.
native_parameters.missingness: Absent is null; uninterpreted supplied fields remain supplied.
native_parameters.identity: Native supplied model parameters, unused in these numerical views

definitions.coordinates: Native labels are not biological rounds. Native endpoints are unchanged; supplied intervals are zero-based half-open. Full query, selected span and profile/master axes remain distinct.
count_populations: JSON reported_hit_count counts all raw hit records; reported_hsp_count sums raw HSP-list lengths only when every hit has a list; observed_hsp_count sums present lists, including malformed entries.
Table reported_hsp_count and observed_hsp_count count original data rows. reported_hit_count uses the collector's original grouping only with every row assignable. Empty undeclared table6 is unknown.
parsed_hit_count and parsed_hsp_count count validated projection containers, not valid geometry; declared_alignment_row_count preserves the table declaration separately.
definitions.threshold_sources: Finite nonnegative native params.include is retained. Only qualified sequence stages apply it and/or agreeing source-qualified effective inclusion_ethresh; DELTA domain stages apply only domain_inclusion_ethresh. Units are expected-count cutoffs; no inclusion decision is inferred.
definitions.membership_population: Supplied checkpoint native member identifiers: raw=len(members); unique=distinct(namespace,value,version); duplicate=raw-unique; included=unique only for complete source-qualified consistent associations. No query subtraction, sequence-digest inference or native decoder is supplied.
definitions.comparison_population: Only explicitly paired complete retained returned target sets under the supplied identity basis: added=L\E, removed=E\L, retained=E intersection L; counts are cardinalities. Reporting limits remain attached. These are not complete database populations or independent evidence.
definitions.convergence_meaning: Explicit source-associated native boolean observations only. Missing is unknown; conflicts are incompatible. Query scope is never attached to a guessed final search. No episode continuation/completion meaning.
child_component_definitions: blast_sequence_database.blast_sequence_database_result_components_v1 embeds unchanged database_sheet, function_weights, coordinate_context, selected_query_coverage and row_keys.
blast_pssm_calculators.blast_pssm_components_v1 embeds all matrices, diagnostics, statistics, master maps, statuses and definitions unchanged.
definitions.missingness: Measured zero, missing_input, not_measured, incompatible_input, invalid_native_row and partial_output are distinct. Native readable scalar cells do not authenticate custody or biological publication.
definitions.uncertainty: No new uncertainty model. Counts and set cardinalities have no external denominator; native statistical quantities and any supplied uncertainty remain in the child results and original records.
definitions.no_cross_round_combination: No sum, mean, product, final-round selection, drift score or inferred convergence across rounds or checkpoints.
definitions.unused_inputs: All native fields, options, unknown extensions, supplied metadata and records remain retained. Child formulas alone specify used/unused measurements; stored taxonomy/source quality does not imply weighting. Observation provenance is not an executable extractor.
